answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 167897 Country: India Title: Praying in Clothes Contaminated with Chemicals: Is It Permissible? Question: I am working in chemical company. Some time, some amount of chemical spilled on my clothes and it cannot be removed without proper washing. Is It permissible to do pray in the same clothes? Answer ID: 167897 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 416/378/H=04/1440) If that chemical does not contain any impure substance then salah will be valid in those clothes. However, if the stains are in such a quantity that it is not good to go in the meeting of respected people wearing the clothes then it is makrooh to offer salah in such clothes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
